description:
Identify the river station with the maximum flood depth (Peak Water Surface Elevation - Minimum Channel Elevation) from the Muncie simulation results. 

1. Analyze the HEC-RAS results file (`Muncie.p04.tmp.hdf`) to find the cross-section with the maximum depth.
2. Generate a plot of this critical cross-section showing the terrain profile, peak water surface elevation (as a filled blue area), and bank stations.
3. Save the plot as a PNG image to `/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/critical_section_plot.png`. The plot title must include the River Station ID.
4. Save a text report to `/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/critical_section_info.txt` containing the River Station ID and the calculated Max Depth (in feet).
